responsibility: Implements the handwritten C target hooks for the Epiphany backend that complement epiphany.md. This file owns most architecture- and ABI-specific backend behavior: option override and register setup, calling convention and varargs decisions, address legitimacy and reload support, cost and scheduling hooks, vector/alignment and constant/frame layout hooks, attribute handling for interrupt and forwarder_section functions, function entry/thunk assembly emission, and the mode-switching hook implementations used for floating-point rounding-state management. In effect it consumes GCC RTL/tree/target-hook callbacks and produces the target-specific decisions and assembly-level support that drive code generation for Epiphany.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C implementation file for the Epiphany port: it defines and wires up target hooks and helper routines such as option override, calling/argument logic, address/reload handling, attribute processing, function/thunk asm emission, and FP mode-switching support, whereas epiphany.h provides the target macros/declarations, epiphany.md encodes RTL instruction patterns and attributes, and epiphany.opt declares the -m option table.
